transcript.text: Now let's compute leading region per the working definition: region with highest count of orders, joining customers to orders.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
West has the highest order count (339), matching the saved "leading region" definition (region with the most orders by customer region).

Note: there's a separate saved note calling South the "flagship region" — a different, distinct concept from "leading region," so it doesn't apply here.
